entries.title: Psalms 51:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David, when Nathan the prophet came unto him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba.>> Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.

words.text: unto him, after he had gone in

entries.title: Psalms 51:2
segments: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

entries.title: Psalms 51:3
segments: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin [is] ever before me.

entries.title: Psalms 51:4
segments: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done [this] evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, [and] be clear when thou judgest.

words.text: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned

entries.title: Psalms 51:5
segments: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me. {conceive...: Heb. warm me}

entries.title: Psalms 51:6
segments: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden [part] thou shalt make me to know wisdom.

words.text: [part] thou shalt make me to know

entries.title: Psalms 51:7
segments: ¶Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

words.text: me, and I shall be whiter

entries.title: Psalms 51:8
segments: Make me to hear joy and gladness; [that] the bones [which] thou hast broken may rejoice.

entries.title: Psalms 51:9
segments: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.

entries.title: Psalms 51:10
segments: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me. {right: or, constant}

entries.title: Psalms 51:11
segments: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.

entries.title: Psalms 51:12
segments: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me [with thy] free spirit.

entries.title: Psalms 51:13
segments: [Then] will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.

entries.title: Psalms 51:14
segments: ¶Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: [and] my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness. {bloodguiltiness: Heb. bloods}

entries.title: Psalms 51:15
segments: O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.

entries.title: Psalms 51:16
segments: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give [it]: thou delightest not in burnt offering. {else...: or, that I should}

entries.title: Psalms 51:17
segments: The sacrifices of God [are] a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

entries.title: Psalms 51:18
segments: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.

entries.title: Psalms 51:19
segments: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.
